description:
JVM (Java/Scala) bindings for json-tools-rs, exposed as Apache Spark UDFs for use
    in Databricks Jobs/notebooks on classic compute and other Spark workloads (not
    usable inside a Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline -- Databricks does not permit JVM
    libraries on pipeline compute at all). Backed by a JNI shim over the Rust core
    (see ../src/jvm.rs).
